description: Wall chain check script, seed 1, one player, peaceful: the four workers are given a chain of wooden walls clicked out from point to point, one order per stretch as the client sends them: a click at (0, 20) for the anchor wall, then east 9 columns, south 5, south-west 3 (a diagonal, built as a staircase so nothing meets only at a corner), west 6 and north 8 back to the anchor, whose wall stands by then and is passed over without a word: 34 walls, a closed ring, from the 40 softwood lumber the camp starts with. At step 300 a second chain, started with Shift so it queues after the ring, runs east 9 from (0, 34) south of the ring: of its 10 columns one, (6, 34), holds a plant and is skipped, and the stock less the ring's planned walls covers 6 of the other 9, so 6 are planned from its start; the player is told both. The workers build each chain from its anchor outward, and all 40 walls stand by step 1500. Building spots are columns (45 cm); ids as of M11: workers are units 1 to 4, the softwood wall is building kind 12.
